scientific_question: After freezing the independently fitted static two-spectrum c_fc coordinates, does the exact same-coordinate context-gate perturbation have reproducible positive projection onto the routed heldout residual left by that static function?

parent_result.finding: Refitting the beta-1 multiplicatively gated map lowers heldout recovery by 0.0556-0.0557 versus the exact same-run beta-0 control despite healthy fits. No beta or operator sweep is authorized.

causal_reconciliation.why_this_audit_is_needed: A direct-sum architecture would preserve the accepted static action and add a separate context component, whereas the rejected treatment multiplied and refit the entire static path. Before allocating any coordinates to a direct summand, the exact context perturbation of the frozen static function must align with the residual it leaves.
causal_reconciliation.no_new_fit: This audit loads the already fitted static coordinates and applies no optimizer, coordinate update, checkpoint update, basis selection, or heldout selection.
causal_reconciliation.residual_projection_equivalence: For static action y0, target y*, and context perturbation q=y_beta1(z0)-y_beta0(z0), projecting q onto r=y*-y0 is exactly the orthogonal residual-complementarity test. An optimal positive scalar separates direction from the beta=1 magnitude, while a discovery-selected scalar tests transfer.

frozen_operator.coordinates: Use each bank/layer's parent control state unchanged. Candidate spectra, parent treatment spectra, and every optimizer state are ignored.
frozen_operator.context_action: q(x)=expert_beta1(x,z_static)-expert_beta0(x,z_static), including the exact GELU and terminal dense c_proj on each side.
frozen_operator.residual: r(x)=expert_dense_target(x)-expert_beta0(x,z_static), aggregated with terminal top-2 routing and probabilities.

direction_metrics.transferred_alpha: Select alpha on the source discovery bank and apply it unchanged on heldout.

data_protocol.anti_leakage: Each bank's scalar is selected only on its own discovery frame. Heldout values cannot choose signs, coordinates, beta, scalar, threshold, or successor.

decision_rule.pass: Only an all-gate pass authorizes theory and preregistration for one fixed-total-coordinate direct-sum allocation. It does not authorize a fit, implementation, MFU preflight, training, or larger rung by itself.
decision_rule.fail: Close the exact multiplicative-context component, including direct-sum reuse of this gate. Do not sweep beta, signs, spectra, scalar, data, or gates. Return to a different coefficient/dictionary algebra or retain dense expert c_fc.
decision_rule.systems: Expected below five minutes and foreground-polled. If observed runtime reaches five minutes, stop foreground polling and attach one terminal/error-only @Codex watchdog before continuing.

systems.monitoring: Foreground polling only; no long-run watchdog for this analysis.
